program: classical energies / Yggdrasil external synthetic research
classification: DEVELOPMENT only; no protected native science first-use
status_at_freeze: PRIMARY UNRUN; only smoke source seed 99059 used for implementation qualification
hypothesis: An actually fitted sparse contrastive-margin energy for native binary action-consequence constraints can beat the strongest fully trained conventional control on disjoint and shifted interventions at comparable data/capacity and lower fit-plus-inference computational cost.
source: Self-authored deterministic 8-bit synthetic causal worlds; all code generated from public seed-keyed action intervention draws; no external dataset or native Yggdrasil state.
inputs: 8 binary intervention inputs, 256 possible input combinations per world; unknown deterministic consequence generated from 3 hidden signed parity/AND factors; conditional consequence bit is observed only after chosen intervention.
intervention_splits: iid/heavy_noise: 96 fitting from SHA-shuffled all 256, 64 disjoint held. shift_x0: fit only x0=0, evaluate only x0=1, no held fitting. No model sees evaluator's true factor IDs/signs.
energy_mechanism: learned nonconvex sparse E(y|x)=-y (w dot phi(x)); observed negative-label contrastive margin updates, strongest-8 gradient and hard top-12 support pruning; one field-evaluation prediction after fitting; not an exact Bayesian reparameterization.
feature_dictionary: 190 fixed parity degree 1..4 and pairwise AND features. Same 190 features and 96 labels accessible to energy, OMP, logistic and ridge. Source family rules are evaluator-side and not passed to learners.
fitted_controls: OMP trained with <=12 active feature couplings (capacity-matched); logistic L2 max_iter=500 tol=1e-8; dense ridge alpha 3; RBF SVM C=2; depth-8 decision tree; all fit from identical training action/outcome rows. Shuffled-energy sees permuted noisy labels; majority constant is diagnostic.

prereg_gates.iid_accuracy_vs_strongest: >=+3pp accuracy over highest IID result among OMP12, logistic, ridge, RBF-SVM, tree (denominator 4608)
prereg_gates.shift_accuracy_vs_strongest: >=+3pp accuracy over highest x0-shift result among same five trained controls (denominator 4608)
prereg_gates.heavy_noise_nonregression: no worse than 1pp below best of those controls at 30% label corruption
prereg_gates.seed_stability: on at least 2 of 3 primary seeds, energy beats strongest control on both IID and shift
prereg_gates.learned_vs_shuffled: energy strictly more correct than same-model shuffled-label negative on all 3 scenarios
prereg_gates.efficiency_vs_fastest_control: sum of local measured per-arm fitting+prediction seconds <=0.5 x minimum such duration among five trained conventional controls; preprocessing/hosting excluded; never call this end-to-end speedup

decision: DEVELOPMENT_GO iff all six frozen boolean gates true. Otherwise DEVELOPMENT_NO_GO, stop this candidate. Even GO is not SCIENTIFIC_PASS or automatic Yggdrasil integration.
planned_audit: independent receipt reaggregation, frozen source Git blob SHA/custody, case/population partitions and no-held leakage, deterministic semantic replay, compare full strong-control cohort
runtime: local Python 3.13.5, NumPy 2.3.5, scikit-learn 1.8.0, CPU only; no paid inference
boundaries: no research-controller, runner or scheduling changes
no postscore hyperparameter, source, threshold, seed or split tuning
